entities.name: SCG MAC entity
entities.description: A MAC entity for the Secondary Cell Group that is created when SCG is not part of current UE configuration.

entities.name: MAC main configuration
entities.description: The main MAC configuration for a cell group that can be reconfigured during DAPS bearer configuration.

entities.name: Timing Advance Group
entities.description: A group of cells with the same timing advance value, identified by TAG-Id.

entities.name: timeAlignmentTimer
entities.description: Timer used for maintaining timing alignment for a TAG.

entities.name: SCG establishment condition
entities.description: Condition where SCG MAC is not part of current UE configuration.

entities.name: DAPS bearer configured condition
entities.description: Condition where any DAPS bearer is configured in the UE.

entities.name: tag-ToReleaseList present condition
entities.description: Condition where received mac-CellGroupConfig includes tag-ToReleaseList.

entities.name: tag-ToAddModList present condition
entities.description: Condition where received mac-CellGroupConfig includes tag-ToAddModList.

relations.description: When SCG MAC is not part of current configuration, UE creates SCG MAC entity.
When DAPS bearer is configured, UE reconfigures MAC main configuration excluding tag lists.
When tag-ToReleaseList is present, UE releases indicated TAGs.
When tag-ToAddModList is present, UE adds or modifies TAGs.
When adding or modifying TAGs, UE configures them according to received timeAlignmentTimer.
